newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Thomson-CSF, defence electronics unit of Thomson SA, to be privatised in early 1997, followed by sale of consumer electronics arm Thomson Multimedia after restructuring and recapitalisation, government said on Wednesday.
-- European Monetary Institute head Alexandre Lamfalussy says in an interview that parities between the major European currencies, including the franc and the mark, are correct.
-- Carrefour retail group denies seeking total control of competitor Cora after buying a 33.34 percent stake in its holding company GMB.
